description: PAID $0.001 USDC. Use when an agent needs a current price for a major US stock or ETF (TSLA, NVDA, SPY...) from Chainlink oracle feeds read on-chain. Returns JSON Chainlink on-chain price for the ticker with 24h and 7d change.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

ticker.description: US stock or ETF ticker that has a Chainlink on-chain feed. Format: uppercase ticker. Example: TSLA. The tool text also names NVDA, SPY, and QQQ. Required.

name: stock_price
title: On-chain stock/ETF price ($0.001)
